steps.en: Officer searches for a notice in OCMS
steps.why_en: Search is generic, not for recording mention outcomes.
steps.why_id: Pencarian umum, bukan untuk mencatat hasil mention.

steps.en: Officer records the mention outcome (DNATA, adjournment, withdrawal)
steps.id: Officer mencatat hasil mention (DNATA, adjournment, withdrawal)
steps.why_en: No screen or option exists to record a mention outcome.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau pilihan untuk mencatat hasil mention.

steps.en: The notice is updated with the recorded mention outcome
steps.id: Notice diperbarui dengan hasil mention yang dicatat
steps.why_en: Nothing stores a mention outcome on a notice.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyimpan hasil mention pada notice.
